name: FoliageRule
doc: Seeded procedural placement rule, evaluated on workers in global cell space.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Source model or foliage asset; resolves to cooked mesh/impostor LODs.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Explicit deterministic seed, independent of request/iteration order.

fields.name: cellSize
fields.doc: Global candidate-cell width in metres, strictly positive.

fields.name: density
fields.doc: Expected accepted instances per square metre before surface masks.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Inclusive elevation range in world metres.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: Splat channel controlling density, zero to three.

fields.name: minWeight
fields.doc: Minimum terrain weight required before multiplying density by that weight.

fields.name: noise
fields.doc: Low-frequency deterministic noise modulation (zero disables it).

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Whether this rule participates in regeneration.
